q1_issues.issue: "often" is encoded only by lowering that single atom's strength to 0.8, with no QuantifierPhrase companion, so the frequency word itself is unrecorded and is indistinguishable from a hedge on the time — the instruction set requires the companion whenever the word is actually there.
The hedge "AROUND Midsummer" is dropped: the Time atom records the bare named time as though it were the exact stated time.

q2_gaps: a frequency adverb on a bare EXISTENTIAL ("there are often many parties") — the companion form is (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>") and "there are" supplies no verb lemma, and nothing says which atom of an existential carries the frequency strength
approximation ("around / about") on a NAMED, non-numeric time — ParticleFromNormal is defined only for a numeric clock/calendar value, so the hedge on "around Midsummer" has no carrier
notes: The group witness plus CardinalityPhrase "many" for the counted existential and the Name atom for Midsummer follow the instruction set; attaching Time to a group of event-denoting nouns extends the event-noun route to group level.
